title: feat(nssamxinc): nssame x-probe same-tick union own-lock: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Same-tick union own lock on nssame x-probes: both bits HOLD even though the seed letters are identical (+e1/+e1) and L(A) is UNDEFINED - the hold runs entirely through the neighbour channel (-e3 vs +e3). Directly bounds #7159: same-letter seeds do not forbid reverse, they only remove the own-letter channel.
